description: The full card for one family office: profile, AUM / RAUM / 13F value kept apart with their as-of dates, behaviour, the people who run it with roles, its observed investments, relationships, recent events, evidence rows and cross-graph links (same_as by shared CRD/CIK/EIN). Contact points are withheld over MCP. Accepts dfx:fo: ids.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id: dfx:fo:<uuid> (family office graph), dfx:isi:<uuid> (sponsor graph), dfx:vc:<uuid> (venture graph), dfx:pe:<uuid> (private equity graph), dfx:ria:<uuid> (registered investment adviser graph), dfx:al:<uuid> (allocator graph), dfx:pc:<uuid> (private credit graph), dfx:ref:<uuid> (real estate fund graph), or a bare real estate UUID.

name: get_family_office
title: One family office in full
